  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static AdditionalPaddle getInstance(danogl.util.Vector2 topLeftCorner, danogl.util.Vector2 dimensions, danogl.gui.rendering.Renderable paddleImage, danogl.gui.UserInputListener inputListener, danogl.util.Vector2 windowDimensions, int hitCount)
      Get the instance of the AdditionalPaddle.
      Parameters:
      topLeftCorner - Position of the paddle, in window coordinates (pixels). Note that (0,0) is the top-left corner of the window.
      dimensions - Width and height in window coordinates.
      paddleImage - The renderable representing the object. Can be null, in which case the GameObject will not be rendered.
      inputListener - The input listener to use.
      windowDimensions - The dimensions of the window, in window coordinates.
      hitCount - The number of hits the additional paddle has taken.
      Returns:
      The instance of the AdditionalPaddle.

    • onCollisionEnter

      public void onCollisionEnter(danogl.GameObject other, danogl.collisions.Collision collision)
      Called when a collision occurs with this GameObject. Resets the instance of the AdditionalPaddle when the hit count reaches the maximum.
      Overrides:
      onCollisionEnter in class danogl.GameObject
      Parameters:
      other - The GameObject with which a collision occurred.
      collision - Information regarding this collision. A reasonable elastic behavior can be achieved with: setVelocity(getVelocity().flipped(collision.getNormal()));
